name: codex-lsp
description: Expose Language Server Protocol diagnostics, navigation, and explicit formatting tools to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Adds LSP diagnostics, navigation, and formatting tools
interface.longDescription: Codex LSP runs LSP clients inside each MCP process and independent lint checks inside short Hooks. Four static tools provide diagnostics, navigation, rename, and explicit formatting. Hooks never start LSP, auto-format, install tools, or lint-fix.
defaultPrompt: Run check_diagnostics on the files I just edited.
Use lsp_navigation to find references before changing this symbol.
Format the scoped files with lsp_format after I approve the paths.
